Volume, year on year

What the gap looks like

NEFT carries 48.2% of retail value on 3.1% of transactions. Cheques carry 6.4% of value on 0.2%. The count and the money are on different rails.

RecommendationsWhat follows from this

Four moves for the next phase

01
Build acceptance for QR, not for terminals
PoS fell 14% while QR codes grew 25%; onboard merchants with a sticker and a phone.
02
Grow the ticket, not only the count
Push UPI into credit at checkout, bills, rent, tuition and business collections.
03
Manage fraud on rupees, not only on rate
Alert on crore lost per month alongside basis points; mule detection scales with count.
04
Keep funding the large-value rails
NEFT carries 48% of retail value and RTGS averages Rs 72.3 lakh a transaction.
